cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. My forecast said sunny. Clearly I meant your reaction to the refund. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The holiday was ruined by rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Which created the refund and your brightened outlook.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A symbol of optimism. You must read the whole prediction generously.
